title: Two Sum Indices
statement: Given n, a list of n integers, and target t, print two distinct indices (0-based) whose values sum to t. Exactly one solution exists. Print smaller index first.

io_format.input_description: Line 1: n. Line 2: n integers. Line 3: target t.
io_format.output_description: Two integers separated by a space.

hints.text: Brute force works for small n.
Store value→index in a hash map while scanning.

reference_solutions.python:
import sys
data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
n = int(data[0])
nums = list(map(int, data[1:1+n]))
t = int(data[1+n])
seen = {}
for i, v in enumerate(nums):
    if t - v in seen:
        a, b = seen[t-v], i
        print(min(a,b), max(a,b))
        break
    seen[v] = i
